title: Setup: build JUnit at both pins of #5839 and #4466 and run their landed tests
description: Setup for cases R49 (junit-team/junit-framework#5839, the suite engine counts dynamically registered tests) and R50 (junit-team/junit-framework#4466, @TempDir ON_SUCCESS cleanup scoped to the owning test) of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-r01-r50-brief.md; no claims, no verifier. In standalone depth-1 clones under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links-r01-r50/worktrees (JUnit's build reads git metadata), with the Gradle cache resolved online there already (inline, 2026-11-26), offline: R49 with Gradle 9.6.1 on JDK 25, R50 with Gradle 8.13 on JDK 21, no build cache, no build scan, no test retries or predictive test selection. For each case: builds the platform and jupiter module jars at the fix and parent pins, runs the landed test classes (R49: platform-tests SuiteEngineTests, BeforeAndAfterSuiteTests; R50: jupiter-tests TempDirectoryCleanupTests), keeps jars, class digests and classpaths under $O/artifacts/CASE-ROLE/, then overlays the fix's changed test files on a copy of the parent and runs them again, where the new tests are expected to fail. JUnit's builds take several minutes each, so the runs are a job. The last steps delete the build trees.
expected: every step exits 0; the fix and parent steps print 'test rc=0'; each landed step prints LANDED-TESTS-FAIL-ON-PARENT-AS-EXPECTED with the failing tests in $O/logs/CASE-parent-landed.test-offline.failures.txt; the clean steps print 'cleaned'

resources.notes: 6 offline JUnit builds of 8 or 6 modules plus platform-tests/jupiter-tests compilation (an earlier setup's JUnit 6.2 jars took 4m18s online); Gradle daemon 1g, Kotlin in process, test JVMs

steps.name: R49 fix: JUnit 6.2.0-SNAPSHOT module jars, SuiteEngineTests + BeforeAndAfterSuiteTests, jars/classpaths kept
R49 parent: the same with the parent's own test files
R49 landed: the fix's suite-engine test files on a copy of the parent (some expected to fail)
R50 fix: JUnit 5.13.0-SNAPSHOT module jars, TempDirectoryCleanupTests, jars/classpaths kept
R50 parent: the same with the parent's own test file
R50 landed: the fix's TempDirectoryCleanupTests on a copy of the parent (some expected to fail)
